trigger: Follow-up to Sam-authorized braking/recovery repair: fully completed v2 matrix removes cost failures but fails four primary comfort cases. Retain it and separately freeze one conditional-preview refinement.
phase: bounded synthetic development comparison; inspected seed, not held-out confirmation
controller: Start with v2 current native route-local leader request. Also project current nearby vehicles onto reachable same/adjacent paths (v1 graph, limit300m). For same-path forward candidates use v2 continuous following request with projected bumper gap minus2.5m. For adjacent candidates require projected bumper gap>2.5m, and floor their request at0.8*(other_speed-ego_speed), so they can request closing-speed matching but not opening a following gap. Take the minimum candidate/native/cruise request; unchanged measured jerk filter and terminal release. No dwell/latch, future event, role or intent oracle. speedMode31 and native ACC safety stay unchanged.
baseline: Reuse all six hash-verified original smooth-ACC runs. Re-run ramp-44 once with the edited runner and require the complete canonical trace to match the frozen baseline before new treatment runs.
matrix: One exact baseline regression; six cases at 240 m and six at 120 m; first primary case repeated before scaling, plus ramp44 and cutin-on primary repeats: 16 bounded simulations. No outcome-driven v2 tuning. This is a combined engineering revision, not a component-causal ablation.
metrics: Paired maximum/RMS jerk, exceedance/mismatch counts, native gaps/TTC, all requested/completed/waiting/removed/teleported counts, fixed-H and separate-drain total/role/origin boundary time and external wait, ramp exposure/event realization, latch/unknown/terminal-release counts. Report all pairs and repeat hashes.
acceptance: No collision/removal/teleport; all requests complete by bounded drain, physical lanes retained and events realized. Comfort <=2.05 m/s3 for every case; total primary boundary time <= baseline*1.05 for each case as a predeclared engineering cost screen, with every group burden still reported. Passing these inspected fixtures is not scientific or physical acceptance.
viewer: No new render needed for this controller comparison. Inspect and hash existing supplied car/source and its current road reference; keep private asset local.
github: Follow normal tested feature checkpoint workflow; no new asset release or private-car publication. Prior release remains immutable.
limits: Same previously inspected synthetic seed and provisional road; not held-out or physical validation. Current route-local leader observation uses SUMO route context; no event schedule, future trajectory, role or merge-intent oracle. Excluding adjacent vehicles cannot guarantee comfortable response to a sudden cut-in. No communication or learned-policy claim; combined revision does not identify component effects. This is an explicitly adaptive development refinement informed by failed v2; not independent confirmation. Adjacent projected positions are conditional and may not represent actual future conflicts. No further outcome-driven retuning within this edition.
rationale: Current route-local leaders appear too late after lane entry. Restore static same/adjacent forward path possibilities without v1 full-brake latch. Exclude adjacent projections whose whole body is not ahead by the standstill reserve; never request gap-opening relative to an adjacent car below speed matching. Preserve every failed v2 result.
primary_metric: Maximum realized controlled jerk across all six primary cases; paired fixed-H complete-cohort boundary time is co-acceptance gate.
